channel.title: DigiKitPro Blog
channel.description: Technique-first Procreate tutorials and digital art guides from DigiKitPro.

item.title: Best Procreate Brushes for Anime and Manga: Lines, Shading, and Texture
item.description: Learn which Procreate brushes suit anime and manga linework, cel shading and soft styles, with a free liner option and optional DigiKitPro packs.

item.title: Best Procreate Brushes for Beginners: A Simple Starter Kit
item.description: Start drawing in Procreate with a few built-in brushes, try a simple exercise and explore optional free and paid sets for your workflow.

item.title: Best Procreate Brushes for Line Art: How to Choose a Liner
item.description: Compare Procreate line-art brushes by taper, pressure, texture and stabilisation. Try a simple liner test with free or specialist tools.

item.title: Best Procreate Brushes for Portraits: A Workflow-Based Guide
item.description: Compare Procreate portrait brushes for sketching, skin, hair and detail. See when a free guide, focused skin set or broader kit may fit.

item.title: Christmas Procreate Tutorial: Design a Holiday Card with Brushes
item.description: Follow this Christmas Procreate tutorial to build a printable holiday card with stamps, washi tape, chalk lettering, paper, and controlled sparkle.

item.title: Halloween Procreate Tutorial: Paint a Moonlit Pumpkin Scene
item.description: Follow this Halloween Procreate tutorial to build a moonlit pumpkin scene with a PNG asset, fog, warm glow, and restrained sparkle.

item.title: How to Choose Procreate Brushes: A Practical Buying Guide
item.description: Choose Procreate brushes for sketching, portraits or line art. Compare free and paid sets by their marks, contents, compatibility and licence.

item.title: How to Paint Realistic Skin in Procreate: A Layered Workflow
item.description: Paint skin in Procreate with eight steps for values, undertones, blending and texture. Built-in brushes work; specialist tools are optional.

item.title: How to Create Realistic Skin Texture in Procreate
item.description: Learn how to add believable pores, freckles, blemishes, and wrinkles in Procreate without covering your portrait in repetitive digital noise.

item.title: How to Create Realistic Watercolor in Procreate
item.description: Learn how to create realistic watercolor in Procreate by building washes, blooms, granulation, paper grain, and soft-edged layers.

item.title: How to Install Procreate Brushes on iPad: .brushset Step by Step
item.description: Learn how to install Procreate brushes and .brushset files on iPad from Files, including ZIP extraction, in-app import, drag-and-drop, and fixes.

item.title: How to Make Digital Art Look Traditional: 7 Practical Techniques
item.description: Give Procreate art a traditional feel with paper texture, broken edges and layered marks. Compare dry-media and watercolor techniques.

item.title: How to Paint Realistic Hair in Procreate Without Drawing Every Strand
item.description: Paint realistic hair in Procreate by building the silhouette, values, clumps and selected strands—without drawing every individual hair.

item.title: Procreate Blending Brushes: How to Blend Without Plastic Skin
item.description: Compare Smudge, textured blenders and painting over transitions in Procreate. Practise soft edges without losing the texture of your art.

item.title: Best Procreate Canvas Size and DPI for Digital Art
item.description: Choose a Procreate canvas size and DPI for screen art, portraits, line art, and print without sacrificing layer space or texture control.

item.title: The Complete Procreate Portrait Workflow: Sketch to Final Polish
item.description: Follow a repeatable Procreate portrait workflow from reference and canvas setup through construction, values, skin, hair, edges, and final polish.

item.title: Procreate Stamp Brushes vs Painting Brushes: When to Use Each
item.description: Understand the difference between Procreate stamp brushes and painting brushes, when each is useful, and how to paint over stamps so your work stays personal.

item.title: How to Design a Tattoo in Procreate: From Sketch to Stencil
item.description: Learn a responsible Procreate workflow for tattoo concepts: plan the body placement, build clear linework, add value, and prepare a clean stencil reference.
